phases.welcome: Days 1-15 · Introduce Leaf People + immerse in the rainforest — earn the follow.
phases.showcase: Days 16-30 · The rarest leaves, up close — go deeper.
phases.concept: Days 31-45 · Tie the beauty to what Leaf People does.
phases.convert: Days 46-60 · Drive to articles, site & installs.

welcome-leafpeople.label: Welcome · Leaf People
welcome-leafpeople.intent: Introduce the app & mission — the daily escape to the jungle.

jungle-escape.label: Jungle Escape
jungle-escape.intent: Immersive, sensory escapism — transport them to the rainforest.

rarest-jungle.label: Rarest Jungle Plants
rarest-jungle.intent: The wow — the rarest leaves on earth, revealed.

velvet-anthurium.label: Velvet Anthuriums
velvet-anthurium.intent: Dark, suede, dramatic — the plant that stops the scroll.

rainforest-beauty.label: Rainforest Beauty
rainforest-beauty.intent: Understory mood, light, lush foliage. Aspiration & calm.

rarity-value.label: Rarity & Value
rarity-value.intent: The $400-$12k stories. Desire, scarcity, the hunt.

app-identify.label: App · Identify
app-identify.intent: Name any rare aroid from a leaf — the head-to-head proof.

app-learn.label: App · Learn
app-learn.intent: Field guide & Understory deep-dives in the app.

article-fieldguide.label: Article · Field Guide
article-fieldguide.intent: Species spotlight -> 'read the full guide, link in bio'.

article-understory.label: Article · Understory
article-understory.intent: Story/culture spotlight -> 'read it, link in bio'.

community-ugc.label: Community / UGC
community-ugc.intent: Prompt followers to share + tag; reshare the best.

goals.theme: Rolling funnel — exploit winners, keep exploring

goals.theme: Story engine — a spotlight a day from the published library

goals.theme: Genus depth — lean into whichever genus converts best
